candidates.name: Tolosa-Hunt syndrome
support_spans: Diffuse limitation in extraocular movements in the left eye
acute injury to the entire orbital segment of the left optic nerve
candidates.why: The patient's presentation of painful ophthalmoplegia, along with the imaging findings of optic nerve injury, could suggest Tolosa-Hunt syndrome, a rare condition characterized by non-specific inflammation of the cavernous sinus or superior orbital fissure.
candidates.protected_reason: This diagnosis is often missed due to its rarity and the fact that it can mimic other conditions, such as cavernous sinus thrombosis or orbital cellulitis.
